verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents checkpointing agent state or resuming a run after a crash or restart. The Workflow Runtime's general "state management" and "retry" support, and Artifacts that persist outputs beyond the conversation, are adjacent features. They are not durable checkpoint/resume of execution, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can checkpoint agent state so a run can resume exactly where it left off after a crash or restart
